$comment: Canonical list of sensitive-value patterns both redaction paths must catch — the Collector's redaction processor (config/collector.yaml, verified by test/verify.sh) and packages/observability's Sentry beforeSend hook (verified by its own test). Add a case here when either implementation needs to catch a new pattern; both test suites read this same file, so adding one without updating both implementations shows up as a failure on whichever side is missing it. See ADR-00017/00018/00020.
